snippet_primary: > "The standard Iyzico fee for online transactions ranges from 4.29% + 0.25 TRY per transaction depending on your country/region and where your customer is paying from. Note that these fees are collected by Iyzico and do not go to Payhip."
subject_exact: Payhip help center (help.payhip.com/article/371-connect-your-iyzico-account, Dec 31, 2025) states Iyzico standard fee for online transactions is 4.29%+0.25 TRY per transaction, varying by country/region; fees collected by Iyzico, not Payhip
local_qualifiers: Iyzico fee: 4.29%+0.25 TRY per transaction (varies by country/region); collected by Iyzico not Payhip
